kinds.label: Rock
kinds.description: A rock: a sculpted sphere, lumped and chipped by its seed and cut flat underneath to sit on the ground. Its length (x) is its width (y) drawn out by its elongation; a few hundred triangles at most, the detail left to its texture's relief.

params.name: roughness
params.label: Roughness
params.description: How broken its surface is: 0 a smooth, lumpy pebble; 1 jagged, chipped all over.

params.name: edges
params.label: Edges
params.description: How its facets meet: 0 faceted, low-poly, each facet flat with hard edges; 1 rounded, shaded smoothly across them.

params.name: base
params.label: Flat base
params.description: How much of its underside is cut flat, to sit on the ground: 0 none, 1 up to half its height.

params.name: elongation
params.label: Elongation
params.description: How long it is for its width: its length (x) is 1 + 2 × this times its width (y).

kinds.size: its width (y) and height (z) its own; its length (x) its width drawn out by its elongation
kinds.seed: a whole number: one seed, one rock

kinds.label: Bevel
kinds.description: A box or a cylinder with its edges rounded or chamfered by a radius in metres, whatever its size: real geometry, its faces numbered as the prim's, each running on over its half of the edges round it with its texture.

params.name: base
params.label: Base
params.description: What is bevelled: a box, its twelve edges; a cylinder, the rims of its top and bottom.

params.name: edge
params.label: Edges
params.description: How its edges are cut: round, a quarter circle; chamfer, one flat cut at 45°.

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.description: How far its edges are cut back from each face, in metres: a round's radius, a chamfer's setback. At most half its thinnest side.

params.name: segments
params.label: Segments
params.description: Steps round each rounded edge at the finest level; fewer far away. A chamfer has one.

kinds.label: Stairs
kinds.description: A straight flight of stairs rising towards +y: its steps, height and tread make its box (width × steps' run × height). Built as a solid block or as treads between two stringers, with a landing half way up and a railing on either side if asked; the railing stands above its box.

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.description: How many steps, each a riser and a tread: the last one's top is the stairs' height.

params.name: height
params.label: Height
params.description: From the ground to the top of the last step (m); each riser is this over the steps.

params.name: tread
params.label: Tread
params.description: How deep each step is, front to back (m).

params.name: width
params.label: Width
params.description: How wide the stairs are, side to side (m).

params.name: structure
params.label: Built as
params.description: Solid: a block down to the ground. Stringers: treads housed between two sloping beams, open between the steps.

params.name: landing
params.label: Landing
params.description: A flat landing half way up, this deep (m); 0, or no deeper than a tread, for none.

params.name: railing
params.label: Railing
params.description: A handrail on posts along the left side, the right, both or neither, going up.

kinds.size: made by its parameters: width × the steps' run × height

kinds.label: Door
kinds.description: A door in its frame: two jambs and a head round its opening, its leaf plain, panelled or glazed, hung on one side and swinging out towards the front (−y) as far as it is open, a handle each side away from its hinges. Its box is the frame's: width, a wall's thickness, height.

params.name: frame
params.label: Frame
params.description: How wide its jambs and head are (m).

params.name: leaf
params.label: Leaf
params.description: How thick the door itself is (m); no thicker than its frame is deep.

params.name: style
params.label: Style
params.description: Plain: one flat slab. Panelled: four raised panels each side. Glazed: glass in its upper half.

params.name: hinge
params.label: Hinges
params.description: The side it hangs on, seen from in front (−y); its handles on the other.

params.name: open
params.label: Open
params.description: How far it stands open (°), swinging out towards the front: its leaf turns on its hinges, its mesh the same. A behaviour opens and shuts it so.

kinds.label: Window
kinds.description: A window: its frame round its opening, glass in it divided into columns and rows of panes by bars, and a sill standing out to the front (−y) if asked. Its box is the frame's: width, a wall's thickness (or less), height; the sill stands out of it.

params.name: frame
params.label: Frame
params.description: How wide its frame is round the glass (m).

params.name: columns
params.label: Columns
params.description: Panes across, divided by upright bars.

params.name: rows
params.label: Rows
params.description: Panes up, divided by level bars.

params.name: bar
params.label: Bars
params.description: How wide the bars between its panes are (m).

params.name: sill
params.label: Sill
params.description: How far a sill under it stands out to the front (m); 0 for none.

kinds.label: Roof
kinds.description: A roof over a rectangle: gabled (its ridge along x), hipped (sloping on all four sides) or a single slope (low at the front, −y). Its box is all of it, eaves to ridge — its pitch is its height for its depth — solid, the space under it closed, or only its slabs.

params.name: type
params.label: Type
params.description: Gable: two slopes, its ridge along x. Hip: four slopes. Shed: one slope, rising to the back.

params.name: structure
params.label: Built as
params.description: Solid: the space under it closed, its ends walls. Slabs: only the roof itself, open underneath.

params.name: thickness
params.label: Thickness
params.description: How thick its slabs are, and so its edge at the eaves (m).

kinds.label: Column
kinds.description: A column: on a base (a square plinth and a moulding) its shaft, round or square, narrowing towards its top, fluted if asked, under its capital (a moulding widening to a square slab). Its box is all of it, its width the plinth's.

params.name: shaft
params.label: Shaft
params.description: Its shaft round or square.

params.name: base
params.label: Base
params.description: How high its base is (m); 0 for none.

params.name: capital
params.label: Capital
params.description: How high its capital is (m); 0 for none.

params.name: taper
params.label: Taper
params.description: How much narrower its shaft is at its top than at its foot, a share of it.

params.name: flutes
params.label: Flutes
params.description: Grooves down its round shaft; 0 for a smooth one.

kinds.label: Arch
kinds.description: An arch: a wall with an arched opening through it, two piers and the wall over its crown, the arch round, pointed or segmental. Its box is all of it, its width the piers' and the opening's, its depth the wall's.

params.name: shape
params.label: Shape
params.description: Round: a half circle. Pointed: two arcs meeting at a point, as tall as an equilateral triangle. Segmental: a shallow arc, a quarter of its span high.

params.name: pier
params.label: Piers
params.description: How wide each pier is either side of the opening (m).

params.name: crown
params.label: Crown
params.description: How much wall stands over the top of the arch (m).

kinds.label: Fence
kinds.description: A fence or railing along a path of points, its foot at each point's height so that it follows the land: a post on each point and others along each length as far apart as asked, between them pickets on rails, rails alone, or balusters between a bottom rail and a top one. Two points make a straight length; a last point on the first closes it round. Its box is what it makes.

params.name: style
params.label: Style
params.description: Pickets: upright boards on two rails behind. Rails: level rails alone. Balusters: spindles between a bottom rail and a top one.

params.name: height
params.label: Height
params.description: How high it stands over its foot (m).

params.name: spacing
params.label: Posts every
params.description: How far apart its posts are at most along each length (m): they share it evenly.

params.name: post
params.label: Posts
params.description: How wide its posts are along it (m), no wider than it is thick.

params.name: rails
params.label: Rails
params.description: How many rails between its posts.

params.name: gap
params.label: Gap
params.description: The gap between two pickets or balusters (m).

params.name: thickness
params.label: Thickness
params.description: How thick it is across its path (m): its posts, its rails within it.

params.name: points
params.label: Path
params.description: The points its path runs through, a post on each: [x, y, z] in metres in its own frame, z its foot there; two at least; a last one on the first closes it round.

kinds.size: what its points, thickness and height make (m)

kinds.label: Road
kinds.description: A road or path along points, on the ground: a ribbon as wide as asked, its edges mitred at each point, its surface on the heights of the ground sampled under it about every metre along it and every metre and a half across, a slab under it as deep as asked. Two points make a straight length; a last point on the first closes it round. Its box is what it makes.

params.name: width
params.label: Width
params.description: How wide it is (m).

params.name: depth
params.label: Depth
params.description: How far its slab goes down under its surface (m), so that where the ground is not quite where its samples say, no gap shows.

params.name: points
params.label: Path
params.description: The points it runs through: [x, y, z] in metres in its own frame, z the ground there; two at least; a last one on the first closes it round.

params.name: ground
params.label: Ground
params.description: The ground's height under it (m, in its own frame), as the editor that laid it measured it: at each place sampled along it, from its left edge to its right; none: straight between its points' heights.

kinds.size: what its points, width and depth make (m)

kinds.label: Sculpted prim
kinds.description: A sculpted prim, as Second Life and OpenSim have them: its surface a map of points (its sculpt map), stitched as a sphere, a torus, a plane or a cylinder. Never written by hand: a part written with "sculpt" — a lathe, a box, a loft, a sweep or a model — is made one by the sculpt tool, and an OpenSim import brings its own; its stitching, mirror and invert set on its card.

params.name: stitch
params.label: Stitching
params.description: How its map closes on itself: a sphere (poles pinched, round its columns), a torus (both ways round), a plane (open), a cylinder (round its columns).

params.name: mirror
params.label: Mirror
params.description: Whether its map is mirrored across its x.

params.name: invert
params.label: Inside out
params.description: Whether its faces look inward: its winding turned.

params.name: columns
params.label: Columns
params.description: The sides across its map, as its finest level samples it.

params.name: rows
params.label: Rows
params.description: The sides down its map, as its finest level samples it.

params.name: map
params.label: Map
params.description: Its sculpt map as its finest level samples it: (columns + 1) × (rows + 1) points, R, G, B each, row by row from the map's top, as base64 (its range is its length in characters).

behaviours.label: Turns
behaviours.description: Turns round its own up (z) without stopping: a carousel, a fan, a sign.

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.description: How fast it turns, in degrees a second; below 0, the other way.

behaviours.label: Goes and comes back
behaviours.description: Goes from where it is to a point and back, waiting at either end: an elevator, a moving platform.

params.name: x
params.label: Along x
params.description: How far it goes along its own x (m).

params.name: y
params.label: Along y
params.description: How far it goes along its own y (m).

params.name: z
params.label: Along z
params.description: How far it goes along its own z (m).

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.description: How fast it goes (m/s), easing in and out at either end.

params.name: wait
params.label: Waits
params.description: How long it waits at either end (s).

behaviours.label: Door
behaviours.description: Swings open on a click or as someone comes near, and shuts by itself, on its hinges along one of its sides; a door of the door kind opens its own leaf.

params.name: angle
params.label: Opens
params.description: How far it swings open (°); below 0, the other way. A door of the door kind opens up to 110°.

params.name: hinge
params.label: Hinges
params.description: The side it hangs on, seen from its front (−y): its −x side or its +x side.

params.name: trigger
params.label: Opens on
params.description: What opens it: a click; someone coming near — it shuts once they have all gone; or either.

params.name: reach
params.label: Near
params.description: How near someone comes before it opens by itself (m).

params.name: time
params.label: Time
params.description: How long it takes to open, and to shut (s).

params.name: stay
params.label: Stays open
params.description: How long it stays open after a click before it shuts by itself (s); 0, until clicked again.

behaviours.label: Slides
behaviours.description: Slides aside on a click or as someone comes near, and back by itself: a sliding door, a window, a hatch.

params.name: x
params.label: Along x
params.description: How far it slides along its own x (m).

params.description: How far it slides along its own y (m).

params.name: stay

behaviours.label: Conveyor
behaviours.description: Carries whoever stands on it along its own y: an escalator (stairs rise along their y), a moving walkway.

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.description: How fast it carries (m/s); below 0, the other way.

behaviours.label: Follows a route
behaviours.description: Goes from where it is through its points, round and on again or to the last and back, stopping a while if asked — at each point, or only at its ends: a boat on a tour that comes back to port, a train on its line with its station.

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.description: How fast it goes (m/s); where it stops, it slows down and speeds up again at about 1 m/s².

params.name: stop
params.label: Stops
params.description: How long it stops (s), where Stops at says: a port, a station; 0, it goes on through them all.

params.name: at
params.label: Stops at
params.description: Where it stops, as long as Stops says: at every point; or only where it is kept — its station, its port — and, going there and back, at its last point too.

params.name: mode
params.label: Goes
params.description: Round its points and on again, or to the last and back the way it came.

params.name: face
params.label: Faces its way
params.description: Whether it turns to where it goes, as a boat or a train does.

params.name: water
params.label: On the water
params.description: Whether it keeps its height over the sea wherever its points are: a boat.

points.name: points
points.description: Where it goes, in its own frame (m): from where it is kept through each point in turn.

since.name: since
since.description: When it set off from where it is kept, in the epoch's ms: set as it is chosen or changed on the card; 0, as if at the epoch.

vehicles.description: Driven on its wheels — its cylinders lying across it — the front ones steering: W and S throttle and brake, A and D steer, Space the hand brake.
